up: Return the exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4513082. Include the standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Also include the ChEMBL ID of the compound tested.
sql: SELECT activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id FROM activities JOIN molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno WHERE activities.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513082')
